text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as the Oka Sho drew near—

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
—What do you think? Is the top favorite
still the Junior-class Queen,
Lucky Lilac?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
First, that would make sense.
As of last year, her mental and technical prowess
were exceptionally refined. Plus—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
There are even rumors that she received personal coaching from Orfevre before her debut.
I think that adds to the drama as well.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Following Orfevre's Classic Triple Crown,
her disciple aims to achieve the Triple Tiara.
Many voices eagerly anticipate such a story—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since spring came, it's been like this non-stop.
Folks covering me in all sorts of ways and all."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Aye. I can feel how much folks are expectin' of me, and it makes me kinda happy that they see a connection between me and Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Because of that, half-hearted running won't be tolerated.
Even so, that's exactly what I'm hoping for."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: After all, I am the Junior Class Queen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we head off to training soon?
We still need to fine-tune things heading into the Oka Sho.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's get to work today too.
Yeah, let's keep at it today too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Oh, the one over there is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...â
One more, please...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
……Ai-san.
Looks like you're giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Almond Eye.
She's a classmate of Lucky Lilac's,
as well as a member of the same generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like Lucky Lilac, she's an honor student
known for her exceptional abilities.
She will likely be our greatest rival in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's currently training
with other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...She's from the same generation as Orfevre-san
and made a name for herself as a world-class sprinter,
right?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I've been seeing Ai-san asking around
about running quite a lot lately."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Just as I learned from Orfe-san,
Ai-san is surely learning something from that person right now—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...It's quite a twist of fate, isn't it?
Through me and Ai-san, it feels like Orfe-san and the others are connected as well."
choice_data_list: That sort of thing happens from time to time in the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vertical ties spanning generations manifest as rivalries in the "present," and race fans find romance and drama in them. It is a tale repeated since time immemorial.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...If the audience sees the clash between
Orfevre and the others reflected in
the showdown between me and Ai-san—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Now I've got another reason
why I can't afford to lose to Almond Eye-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she gazed at Almond Eye, a flame of fighting spirit flickered quietly, yet undeniably fiercely, within her eyes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then came the day of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete.
Well then, I'm off.
choice_data_list: Let's revel in today's Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: ...You know, since it's the Oka Sho... cherry blossoms and all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to add anything!!
That just makes it even more ridiculous!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Trainer...
Dropping a pun of that caliber at a time like this makes you a bold one, in a way.
choice_data_list: Was that a good warm-up for your tsukkomi?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to you, I've warmed up properly.
I feel like I can make a good, sharp charge in the race too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please watch my run.
Once more here at Hanshin,
I will surely bloom in all my glory.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it! Take care!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(What's this? The atmosphere is heavy.
It's different from the Hanshin JF. This is――)
The day is finally here, Lara!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I have been looking forward to competing
with you in this Oka Sho for so long...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see which of us is stronger...!
A fair and square showdown!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fine by me, Ai-san.
Let's compete. But only if—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"When I finally grasp the cherry blossoms,
will you be there to watch me from the front row?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Lara.
And that's why right now, you're the one I want to beat...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go.
To the Oka Sho, where we'll dance and compete—
